title: The query-log redactor catches a long token after an equals sign and the common cloud key shapes
goal: redact.redact replaces a token of 20 or more characters holding a letter and a digit after key= (today the TOKEN lookbehind at redact.py:81 refuses an = before it, so token=<32 chars> survives while token: is caught), keeping the words filter so identifiers stay; kbcommon.SECRETS gains the Google API key (AIza), Stripe live key (sk_live_), npm token (npm_) and SendGrid (SG.) shapes, and the Entra client-secret shape only after it is confirmed against Microsoft Learn (a kb fact or source row). Measured on ST-yl6b2ues's corpus: the key x separator x value matrix leaks at most 12 of 360 (93 today), utility rows unchanged, the rewrite rate on engineering text at most 0.8% (0.7% today). Key-name and command-flag forms (cmdkey, net use, sqlcmd -P, XML Password) are out of scope. Stored entries that fail check after the widening are re-redacted with querylog.py reredact as querylog.md says. Evidence: reliability-authority-review.md RD-2.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import redact as r;v='Zx9Qm4'+'Lp7Rt2Vb8Nc5Kd3Wf6Hj';s='token='+v;g='AI'+'zaSyD'+'Qm4Lp7Rt2Vb8Nc5Kd3Wf6Hj01234567';ok=v not in r.redact(s) and g not in r.redact('key '+g);print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon as k;t='Qm4Lp7Rt2Vb8Nc5Kd3Wf6Hj01';vals=['AI'+'za'+'SyD'+t+'2345678','sk_'+'live_'+t,'npm_'+t+'Ab9x8Yz7Wq','SG'+'.'+t[:22]+'.'+t+'Ab9x8Yz7Wq6Vu5Ts4Rp'];miss=[v[:6] for v in vals if not k.leak_hits('key '+v)];print(miss);sys.exit(0 if not miss else 1)
